notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Bug fixed

Fixed a bug that may cause characters' name will appear in the wrong position on dialogue
Fixed a bug that may cause invisible avatars on dialogue
Fixed a bug that may cause "Ice Cream" can not combine with "Silver Spoon" at "Quality" event,
Fixed a bug that may cause entires will be deleted in accident and game stuck at "Flu" event
Fixed a bug that may cause not all "Flowers" in Chapter 3 could be collected
Fixed a bug that causes some entries names can not display in full
Fixed some texts on entries' description
Fixed some display bugs on texts in English version
Fixed some display bugs on tutorial in English version
Fixed some display bugs on collection view in Traditional Chinese version
Fixed a problem that may cause some achievements can not unlock
Fixed some display bugs after switching resolution
Fixed a bug on Album that may cause game freeze & unable to turn page

New features:
1. The default language is now consistent with the Steam interface language.
2. Added a new setting saving function, and the settings in the menu can be saved manually.


Welcome to join our Discord! (On Visual Novel Channel)

notes.title: Free Trial Demo | Raising Daughter in the Millennium
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633732/5f346bcb719c3311591a178a29becab4083472fd.jpg
Hello, new parents! Thank you for your patience. After 3 months of development and optimization, we are pleased to announce: 

Our existential life simulation game "Fragment: A Story In Growing " will be officially launched on June 25!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2821690/

The production team will gradually optimize and update features based on the feedback from the test players in the near future.

Also we will debut at Steam's Eastern GameFest on April 26, 2024, with a brand-new promotional video and playable Demo!

Looking forward to your feedback！


What's new in the DEMO?
Your middle school daughter seems to have her own secrets, causing you endless worries. Meanwhile, a colleague's words unexpectedly trigger memories of your deceased wife... How will you navigate this family crisis? 

The time machine to your daughter's 15th birthday is about to start. 3, 2, 1... Let's go!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633732/daa947abf57fa1a1785ffad5d35f6f34e02bba1e.gif

v1.3 Version Update
Function Updates

 Added local save function.
 Added English localization support.
 Added windowed mode and resolution adjustment in settings.
 Added volume adjustment in settings.
 Revised game structure and added a plot node selection interface.
 Added level system and gameplay for level tasks.
 Added illustration function.

Content Updates

 Revised beginner tutorial for better understanding!
 Optimized plot text and added more branching details.
 Overall UI updates.
 Added some game CGs and numerous illustrations.
 Added some background music and sound effects.
